watch.en: Heat the sugar until it melts and turns a deep brown.
watch.de: Den Zucker erhitzen, bis er schmilzt und tiefbraun wird.

why.en: Heat acting on melting sugar changes it into a deep brown colour with new flavours.
why.de: Hitze verwandelt schmelzenden Zucker in eine tiefbraune Masse mit neuen Aromen.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BCcampus)
sources.sentence: At high temperatures, the chemical changes associated with melting sugars result in a deep brown colour and new flavours.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BCcampus)
sources.sentence: Caramelization results from the action of heat on sugars.
